qualification: Selected summaries of synthetic headless runs, not raw traces or physical-terminal latency. Run status checks blank frames and applicable monotonicity; it does not certify cross-run destination equality. Up/down equality uses logical anchor and native cursor position, not global estimated scrollTop. Each pair is exploratory, not an independent-trial latency distribution.
